records.outcome: Public program for OGLE-2024-BLG-0062 describes multiple filters, repeated seasons and reference-star astrometry. Used as a design example for another event, not an observing allocation or exposure plan for this target.
Official STScI documentation specifies the 85-to-135-degree solar-elongation field of regard. The bound is the only observatory constraint used in the new approximate window calculation.
Official GTVT documentation distinguishes quick-look visibility from APT schedulability and guide-star/other constraints.
records.limit: GTVT and APT were not run during this initial web check. A subsequent GTVT run and date-alignment audit are documented in gtvt-audit.json; APT remains pending.

records.outcome: Read primary paper's section2.3/equation6 and observing discussion: isolated-source centroid shift u/(u^2+2) times thetaE, maximum at sqrt(2), and astrometric tail longer than photometric event.

Primary Lam etal2022 paper/abstract records the need for joint astrometric/photometric interpretation and source-model alternatives in OGLE-2011-BLG-0462. No claim that the old papers alone settle the current census of confirmed isolated black holes.
